title: Oregon Business Registry Active Registrations
description: Governed Oregon Secretary of State active-registration layer using only selected non-agent principal-place rows, with legal-entity versus assumed-business-name identity, ZIP/ZCTA context, provenance, and explicit non-site semantics.
coverage_claim: Registrations listed in the official Oregon Active Businesses dataset with at least one principal-place row; this is source-specific active-registration evidence, not a census of every operating business or physical site.
identity_rule: Legal-entity registrations become provisional organization candidates. Assumed Business Name registrations become provisional brand candidates because an assumed name is not necessarily a legal organization and its owner is deliberately excluded.
